## 合作与问题反馈 {.section-title #feedback}

```{=html}
<div class="panel">
  <form id="feedback-form">
    <div class="form-grid">
      <label class="form-field">
        <span>姓名</span>
        <input required name="name">
      </label>
      <label class="form-field">
        <span>邮箱</span>
        <input required type="email" name="email">
      </label>
      <label class="form-field">
        <span>问题类型</span>
        <select name="type">
          <option>数据勘误</option>
          <option>数据申请</option>
          <option>学术合作</option>
          <option>其他</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label class="form-field">
        <span>涉及地区 / 变量</span>
        <input name="subject">
      </label>
      <label class="form-field full">
        <span>详细说明</span>
        <textarea required name="message"></textarea>
      </label>
      <div class="form-field full">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">提交</button>
        <div id="form-msg" style="color:#0c766f;font-weight:700;margin-top:0.5rem"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>
</div>
```
